WATCHERREBALANCE-CORE_CHANGES.title: Core Changes
WATCHERREBALANCE-REBALANCED_STRENGTH_SCA: When enabled, Strength is not effected by Stance Damage Multipliers.
WATCHERREBALANCE-SCALING_DIVINITY_REQUIR:
When enabled, the Mantra required to enter Divinity increases by 5 each time Divinity is entered during combat.
[gold]Requires a restart.[/gold]
WATCHERREBALANCE-CALM.title: Calm
Damage multiplier applied to damage dealt while in Calm.
WATCHERREBALANCE-CALM_DAMAGE_TAKEN_MULTI: Damage multiplier applied to damage received while in Calm.
WATCHERREBALANCE-WRATH.title: Wrath
WATCHERREBALANCE-WRATH_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER: Damage multiplier applied to attacks dealt while in Wrath.
WATCHERREBALANCE-WRATH_DAMAGE_TAKEN_MULT: Damage multiplier applied to damage received while in Wrath.
WATCHERREBALANCE-DIVINITY.title: Divinity
WATCHERREBALANCE-DIVINITY_DAMAGE_MULTIPL: Damage multiplier applied to attacks dealt while in Divinity.
WATCHERREBALANCE-DIVINITY_DAMAGE_TAKEN_M: Damage multiplier applied to damage received while in Divinity.

WATCHERREBALANCE-MULTIPLAYER_CARDS.title: Multiplayer Cards
WATCHERREBALANCE-ENABLE_MANIPULATE_REALI: Use Manipulate Reality instead of Shared Foresight in multiplayer card rewards. Requires a restart.
WATCHERREBALANCE-FUN_STUFF.title: Fun Stuff
WATCHERREBALANCE-ENABLE_BLASPHEMY_EASTER: Enable a secret interaction when playing Blasphemy more than once in the same combat.
WATCHERREBALANCE-USE_OMNIPRESENCE.title: Use Omnipresence
Use Omnipresence instead of Gift of Miracles. Requires a restart.
WATCHERREBALANCE-USE_LEGACY_MANIPULATE_R: Use the original Manipulate Reality artwork rather than Shared Foresight artwork. Requires a restart.
WATCHERREBALANCE-USE_LEGACY_MULTIPLAYER_: Use Onslaught and Fleeting Clarity instead of Hold Fast and Stance Blessing. Requires a restart.
WATCHERREBALANCE-USE_ANCIENT_RUSHDOWN.ho: Use the rebalanced Ancient Rushdown instead of Clairvoyance. Requires a restart.
WATCHERREBALANCE-USE_ERUPTION_REVELATION: Use the rebalanced Eruption Ancient transformation instead of Vigilance Revelation. Requires a restart.
